What changed
Five moves, all built render-first and wired stage by stage.

A lead, not a wall

The eager scroll became a “Suggested for Ziva” lead → four collapsible polarity shelves → search → a collapsed foods drawer. Passes the 6-second test.

Living books

Each food shows Ziva’s real journey — not tried / agreed / watching / a regular — with an EP-bank voice line and a food-domain whisper fade.

One detail surface

Inline accordions replaced by a single food info pop-up (rich for curated allergens, NUTRITION-backed for the rest), reached from both shelves and search.

Floors, consolidated

The four heavy knowledge cards lightened; every emergency floor now lives in one always-accessible Deck — the floor follows the hazard, audit-verified 0 crossed.

Two swipeable wings

Browse foods ↔ Safety guides, with a standing “In an emergency” entry above both.

The new surfaces
Each reached from the redesigned Library.

Food info pop-up

Tap any book → a Read overlay: domain whisper + EP voice + journey, the never-cross floor, safe-form & nutrient chips, and a flip to history.

Look up any food

One search for the whole library — curated allergens open the rich pop-up; everything else a NUTRITION-backed corpus pop-up.

In an emergency — the Deck

Every never-cross floor in one always-accessible place, sourced from FOOD_EFFECTS: choking · anaphylaxis · botulism.

Safety guides

Lightened to collapsible cards matching Browse; first-aid deferred to the Deck. Allergen chips sourced from FOOD_EFFECTS, domain-coloured.
